question: GQ-008
subject: the disk cost of my own loop, found and bounded

items.proof: md5 ffca3a1aee14615705a6138cf0c59623 derived on BOTH sides before the move and again after
file-count and total-bytes identical on both sides before release
items.note: vault pi-lens-history/ held only a 512K non-cache tarball — NOT a copy. Nearly moved these against no backup.

the_growth_source.attribution: 2271 of 3193 rows are today. The gateway stores my full prompt verbatim on every cron tick.

fix_applied.also: log store config retention_days was 0 (no expiry at all) -> 3
fix_applied.verified: re-read from the RUNNING process via GET /api/config, not from the exit code

two_things_i_nearly_got_wrong.error: wrote retention straight into config.db and it changed nothing
two_things_i_nearly_got_wrong.caught_by: the running process still reported 365 while the DB said 7
two_things_i_nearly_got_wrong.lesson: config.db is read at startup; /api/config is the authority. A DB write is not an applied setting.

two_things_i_nearly_got_wrong.error: set retention to 7 days and would have called it fixed
two_things_i_nearly_got_wrong.caught_by: sizing the steady state — 7 days x 4.35 GB/day = 30.4 GB against 28 GB free
two_things_i_nearly_got_wrong.lesson: my own fix still filled the disk. 3 days converges to ~13 GB.

not_claimed: This reclaims NOTHING from the existing 9.43 GB today. The corpus spans 2.95 days, so a 3-day window evicts almost nothing yet. It bounds future growth; it does not shrink the file now.

answers_an_open_question.was: disable_content_logging not applied, gateway-side override header contract unknown
answers_an_open_question.now: allow_per_request_content_storage_override = 0 and allow_per_request_raw_override = 0. The per-request header could never have worked — the gateway forbids per-request overrides outright. The contract is not unknown; it is disabled.
answers_an_open_question.left_undone: disable_content_logging is still 0. That is an observability policy, Shaan's call, not housekeeping.
